title: Independent verification: R420 compensation rank and minimum-weight kernel
head: cf5ff54a358b400a7e69abe941d1d0ad0944b25e
body:
This **independent verification** certifies the accepted PR543 R420 dirty-helper correction matrix: **rank 120, nullity 300, minimum nonzero kernel weight 4**, with exactly **18** weight-four kernel vectors. No new circuit or kappa is claimed.

The verifier pulls target observables backward through A/scatter/B, independently of the predecessor's forward symbolic interpreter. It checks J=I, V=I and K=D, both products of an explicit 120-by-120 inverse minor, a complete 300-vector kernel basis, and 120 dirty inputs that each isolate one target error when compensation is omitted. The complete D/A/scatter/B/C scalar endpoint also passes on all 660 input columns.

All 87,990 helper-column pairs are checked to exclude kernel weights below four and enumerate every weight-four support. One exact cancellation uses absolute helpers **{284, 296, 521, 623}**. A separate Boolean interpreter reads the literal source independently and checks all 420 helper-basis directions, plus every nonempty subset of all 18 minimum-weight supports.

A scoped consequence is that a linear factorization of this fixed K through r summaries requires r >= 120. This says nothing about XOR optimality, sequential scratch reuse, or a different supplier.

```sh
python3 -I -B research/r420-compensation-rank80/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/r420-compensation-rank80/test_verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_R420_DIRTY_RANK rank=120 nullity=300 distance=4 pairs=87990 isolated_errors=120 controls=10`, then seven tests pass. Python 3.10+ standard library only.

Validation passed on Linux x86_64 / Python 3.12.3: normal and optimized runs, byte-identical regenerated certificate, minimal clean export, ten rejecting controls, seven obligation tests, the unchanged PR543 frame/scalar/interface checker, selected-record integrity, review-ledger checks and staged whitespace. Controls include a rank-preserving wrong compensation, a dependent kernel basis, and cleanup damage that leaves K unchanged. Source corruption is rejected; gzip recompression is accepted by decoded payload. Full hosted/native construction, repository-wide suites, Lean and remote CI were not rerun or claimed.

Base: `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60`. PR543: `2065fe4f72a914d907f1046603f5a36f17018535`. Selected PR626: `660de893d27bb7abd1d5b01b1640207528a5c851`. Exact source/blob/payload pins, certificate, proof, validation and local claim are included. Only `research/r420-compensation-rank80/` is added. The selected frontier and `upstream/` are unchanged; inherited all-size/compiler, common-label/mutable-basis, hosting, precision/tape and analytic obligations remain.

OS assignment seed **80**, independent-verification track. No pinned coordination issue existed. The final queue refresh covered 547 open PRs through #728. Concurrent #686/#694 helper-basis and #713/#716 target-basis circuits are credited; this adds a different verification method and explicit rank/kernel evidence for their accepted baseline, without importing or certifying their changes. #612's Lean boundary/B work and #717/#718's different scoped limits are distinguished. This is separate from my #695 CI reconciliation and #712 complex cold-wrapper certificate.

Credit remains with **eumemic's PR543** and the original PR493/370/425/472/510 lineage, their preserved notices, and the selected construction authors. Prepared by **Joshua Snider**, with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance** in analysis, implementation, verification and writing. Apache-2.0. Independent implementation does not imply independent human review or a formal proof of integer multiplication.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
